title: The plan requires the model to place each matching category identifier in the published finding title/body
text: The plan requires the model to place each matching category identifier in the published finding title/body. That exposes the per-category mapping in the review body, contrary to AC1's requirement that the per-category record is never published there. Define a non-public attribution mechanism instead.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in c951748, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
